content:
Because of my good fortune, I continue to enjoy a much improved life, which has influenced five members of my family to attend Hippocrates, thereby significantly improving their lives. My wife has been back to the Institute three times, I have been back twice, and we have also taken one of our daughters-in-law and a grandson. This grandson and his wife were attempting to conceive without success. Two months after their first stay at the Institute- utilizing the Hippocrates Program- they finally experienced the joy of becoming expectant parents. We now share health, happiness and a beautiful great-granddaughter. The Hippocrates Wellness has had a positive influence on all our lives. We have also referred many of our associates whose lives have also been improved and, in many cases, saved by what they have learned and employed back home.

I couldn’t recommend anything as strongly as I recommend the Institute. Not only is it a wonderful place, but it is “THE PLACE” to put your life in order for optimum health and enjoyment.

Vol 22 Issue 4 page 3
